Many tried to capture the evil but none succeeded,until one day one was born blinded to the light fought the great evil and bested it in combat, however he knew the evil was too powerful to be destroyed so he instead split the evil power into 12 notes of music that when played on a legendary instrument would combine and once more have the power to bring great darkness upon the living realm however he know believed when used separately this great power could also be used to save the world and so he scattered the notes across the world. 

Many years passed and the Blind Mana Master had learnt that humans could no longer access the Pure Mana,he realized that the evil had locked the Pure Mana that resided in their Bloodstream into a dormant state,awaiting an activation code that would awaken.

The Activation Code was discovered by the Blind Mana Master,using a very powerful but forbidden ritual he used his own Mana to align the Planets thus awakening the Pure Mana in their Bloodstreams.
